old.name: Calella de Palafrugell & Llafranc
old.text: Twin coves linked by the cliff-hugging camí de ronda, an arcaded fishermen's quarter (Les Voltes at Port Bo), the spiritual home of the garoinada. Casamar sits on the Llafranc headland, its door opening straight onto the path's steps.

old.name: Cadaqués & Portlligat
old.text: A whitewashed fishing village at the tip of Cap de Creus, a cobbled maze that fixed itself in Dalí's imagination; Portlligat next door holds the house-museum, the fisherman's hut he bought in 1930 and worked in for fifty years. Compartir Cadaqués, from the elBulli trio, is the town's best table.

old.name: Girona
old.text: The inland capital and gastronomic pole: a medieval Old Town (Barri Vell) above the ochre Cases de l'Onyar restored in 1983–84, one of Europe's best-preserved Jewish quarters (El Call), and the orbit of the Roca brothers — El Celler de Can Roca (three stars since 2009), Restaurant Massana, the Mercat del Lleó, and Jordi Roca's Rocambolesc gelateria.
